label: sec:trefoil-knot
html: The trefoil knot 3_1 = T(2,3), obtained as the closure of \sigma_1^3 \in B_2, is the simplest nontrivial prime knot and serves as the fundamental testing ground for the categorical trace pipeline. Its knot group \pi_1(S^3 \setminus 3_1) \cong B_3 is non-abelian, and its image in the Hecke quotient H_3(q) splits into a one-dimensional abelian character and the two-dimensional irreducible Burau–Hoefsmit representation V_{(2,1)} that every heavier torus knot inherits.
